lab_name: Agentic MSP Support Agent Guided Lab (TOC v3 rebuild)
prepared_by: Amit Kumar (prepared with the CloudLabs Lab Builder)

phases.phase: Redesign for a dedicated tenant per participant (research refresh: Foundry and gpt-5.1, Entra Agent ID and identity passthrough, API Management and Container Apps, Dataverse managed developer environments, Purview pay-as-you-go, Azure AI Search; region move to Canada Central; setup app and role design)
phases.assumptions: Six research notes refreshed on 2026-11-06 with sources and open questions; the settled design is in the build spec, section 3 (Canada Central, one Entra tenant and subscription per participant, OAuth identity passthrough, managed developer environment, certificate-based setup app, Global Administrator removed after provisioning).

phases.phase: Bicep template (main.bicep and 11 modules, Build-Template.ps1 that compiles and checks deploy-01.json, ARM outputs as Environment tab fields) and the governance quartet (ARM policy, custom RBAC, usage policy)
phases.assumptions: Compiles to deploy-01.json; the first live deployment into a dedicated tenant is still to run. API Management MCP APIs need the preview API version 2025-09-01-preview.

phases.phase: Per-tenant provisioning with the setup app (app registrations and admin consent, Purview label, label policy and DLP policy, managed developer environment, Dataverse schema, security roles and column security, seed load, search export, MCP image build and baseline revision, agent and its two MCP OAuth connections, role assignments, Global Administrator removal, readiness check and consistency report)
phases.assumptions: Scripts in setup/assets/labfiles/provision; not yet run end to end in a fresh tenant. Riskiest steps: unattended sign-in in a new tenant, Purview configuration with app-only PowerShell, managed developer environment creation, and the OAuth connection metadata.

phases.phase: MCP server v3.0.0 (read and write endpoints plus diagnostics, 23 tools with output schemas, the Agent Action table, the duplicate guard, Purview processContent checks, correlation logging, tests, build, deploy and rollback scripts)
phases.assumptions: Tests run against the fixture backend in the MCP repository; Dataverse impersonation and the Purview calls are verified live in the pilot.

phases.phase: Data rebuild (120 knowledge articles, 36 customer documents, 500 historical tickets, 60 open tickets plus 2 new incidents, 1,436 ticket notes; deterministic generator, loader, manifest, data tests, DATA-SPEC.md)
phases.assumptions: The seed manifest meets the requirement minimums and gives the 753-document search export; the live load into a managed developer environment is checked in the pilot.

phases.phase: Lab guide: 7 rewritten exercises (27 tasks, 104 steps), getting started, README delivery path, AGENDA, SUPPORT-GUIDE and masterdoc
phases.assumptions: Exercises 1, 2 and 7 are rewritten for v3; Exercises 3 to 6 are being rewritten from the October text. Portal labels come from Microsoft Learn and are flagged where the docs are thin.

phases.phase: 9 animated diagrams (architecture, session journey and one per exercise), SVG sources rendered to PNG
phases.assumptions: SVG and PNG pairs in Instructions/media; prose in each exercise matches its diagram.

phases.phase: 14 validation scripts and the acceptance test suite (the 14 acceptance criteria: login, isolation, baseline consistency, seeded data, grounded retrieval, MCP read and write, redeploy and rollback, authorization denial, secrets, data protection, audit evidence, reset, concurrency, spare recovery)
phases.assumptions: Checks read Azure Resource Manager, Azure AI Search and the MCP server's tool invocation log in Log Analytics as the CloudLabs service principal; GUIDs are minted at registration. Concurrency and reset criteria need real tenants.

phases.phase: Cost and effort estimates for the v3 design
phases.assumptions: Canada Central retail prices retrieved 2026-11-10 from the Azure Retail Prices API; license list prices from the research notes; arithmetic in estimates/ESTIMATE-NOTES.md.

phases.phase: Pilot: one environment end to end with both identities, screenshots and 27 task GIFs, open questions settled, fixes
phases.assumptions: About 60 screenshots and 27 GIFs; settles the pilot items in BUILD-NOTES.md (identity passthrough in the playground, the Tier 1 role, the approval prompt, Purview latency, tokens per participant, the Container Apps environment charge).

phases.phase: Platform onboarding (Dedicated Tenant template with its user-creation JSON and license offer IDs, template library and blob uploads, lab files zip, validation registration)
phases.assumptions: Follows setup/README.md and validation-scripts/README.md; license offer IDs for Microsoft 365 E5 and Power Apps Premium confirmed with CloudLabs first.

phases.phase: Four workshop deliveries with support (per workshop: 27 environments provisioned at least 24 hours ahead, Purview pay-as-you-go enabled by hand in each tenant, readiness sweep and consistency report, live support during the 4-hour window with spare swaps and resets, the 24-hour review window, teardown check and cost reconciliation)
phases.assumptions: 20 to 30 hours per workshop: about 4 to 5 hours of Purview pay-as-you-go enablement (27 tenants x about 10 minutes), 3 hours of readiness checks, 10 hours of live support (two engineers for the window), 3 to 6 hours of review-window support, and 2 to 4 hours of teardown and reconciliation.

risks.risk: Unattended provisioning can't sign in to a new tenant (mandatory MFA, security defaults), or the setup app's certificate flow fails
risks.impact: Provisioning stops before Dataverse, Purview and the agent; the environment never reaches Ready
risks.mitigation: Pilot first in a fresh CloudLabs Dedicated Tenant; keep the bootstrap service principal parameters (bootstrapAppId, bootstrapAppSecret) as the fallback

risks.risk: Purview pay-as-you-go enablement is a manual portal step per tenant, in preview, and can take hours
risks.impact: No DLP block in Exercise 6 for tenants where it is missing
risks.mitigation: Enable it right after provisioning, at least 24 hours ahead; the readiness check asserts a block, not only a successful call

risks.risk: Sensitivity labels take up to 24 hours to apply
risks.impact: Exercise 6 label checks fail on environments provisioned late
risks.mitigation: Provision at least 24 hours ahead (this drives the 58-hour duration); spares come from the same batch

risks.risk: A participant subscription is on the Free Tier or a low quota tier
risks.impact: gpt-5.1 can't be deployed (the Free Tier has no gpt-5.1 quota) or is throttled
risks.mitigation: Check each subscription's quota tier before provisioning; Tier 1 allows 250K TPM, above the 100K TPM deployment

risks.risk: Token use above the estimate, for example if Foundry also sends the MCP output schemas to the model (about 31,700 more input tokens per model call) or the playground runs evaluators
risks.impact: Model use approaches or exceeds the 4M input and 0.4M output token allowance per environment
risks.mitigation: Measure tokens per participant in the pilot; trim tool descriptions and schemas if needed; watch usage during each workshop

risks.risk: Licenses for 216 identities (108 tenants x 2): Microsoft 365 E5 and Power Apps Premium offer IDs and the license basis (per day or per month) are unconfirmed
risks.impact: Purview and the managed developer environment don't work without them; the cost per seat rises from 41.66 to 180.33 USD if licenses are held by the month
risks.mitigation: Confirm offer IDs and the license basis with CloudLabs before the pilot

risks.risk: Preview dependencies: API Management MCP APIs (2025-09-01-preview), agent identity flows, Purview processContent for Entra-registered apps
risks.mitigation: Pin versions, re-test before each workshop, and keep the documented fallbacks under the platform-dependency clause

risks.risk: The Container Apps Environment Management Hour applies to Consumption-only environments
risks.impact: About 5.80 USD more per environment (already in the up-to total)
risks.mitigation: Check Cost Management after the pilot and move the row into the base if it bills

risks.risk: Participant subscriptions funded by free credits
risks.impact: ACR Tasks runs are paused: provisioning and the redeploy exercises fail
risks.mitigation: Use paid subscriptions; keep a pre-built fallback image
